site.title: {project} - Kugovera Mafaira Kusina Pakati
site.description: {project} isofutiweya yekugovera mafaira ye-peer-to-peer yakavakwa pamatekinoroji emazuva ano asina pakati.
site.ogDescription: Kugovera mafaira kwe-peer-to-peer kwakavakwa pamatekinoroji emazuva ano asina pakati. Hapana maseva epakati. Hapana nzvimbo imwe yekukundikana.

hero.subtitle: Chizvarwa chinotevera chekugovera mafaira kwe-peer-to-peer
hero.description: Yakavakwa pamatekinoroji emazuva ano asina pakati. Hapana maseva epakati. Hapana nzvimbo imwe yekukundikana.

about.title: Nezve
about.intro: {project} ipuratifomu yekugovera mafaira ye-peer-to-peer yechizvarwa chinotevera yakavakwa pamatekinoroji emazuva ano asina pakati. Inosanganisa nzira yemushandisi iri nyore neumbo husina pakati zvakakwana, ichipa mhinduro yakachengeteka uye yakavimbika yekugovera data isingadi simba romukati. Chirongwa chiri pachena uye chinopararirwa pasi pe{license}.

decentralized.title: Network isina pakati zvachose
decentralized.description: Hapana maseva epakati, hapana nzvimbo imwe yekukundikana. Vashandisi vanotsvaga uye kudhaunirodha zviri mukati zvakananga pakati pavo, vasingavimbi nezvinyorwa zvepakati, vatsvagiri kana mawebhusaiti edhata.

accessControl.title: Kutonga kupinda kunoongorora
accessControl.description: Munhu wese akasununguka kutanga network yake nemitemo yake. Tsanangura mabasa emushandisi munetwork yega yega: varidzi, maadmin, vaparidzi, vatongi nevanodhaunirodha. Tonga zvachose ndiani anogona kuburitsa, kudzora, uye kudhaunirodha zviri mukati.

ui.title: Nzira yemushandisi yepamusoro
ui.description: Nzira yemedia center yakachena uye iri nyore yakagadzirirwa madhesktopu, maTV nemafoni. Famba pasina dambudziko nekiyibhodhi, mbeva, gamepad kana rimoti. Vashandisi vanoziva vanogona kushandisa command line kushandisa software seseva yefaira isina musoro.

dataFormat.title: Fomati yedhata inoverengwa nemunhu
dataFormat.description: Fomati yedhata yeLISH inotsamira pa-JSON, zvichiita kuti zvive nyore kugadzira, kuverenga uye kunzwisisa. Govera zviri mukati zvako nemetadata yakajeka, yakavhurika inogona kuongororwa zviri nyore neani zvake.

security.title: Sekuru nekuchengetedzwa
security.description: Kutaurirana kwese kwe-peer-to-peer kwakavharirwa, kuchionesa kuti dhata yako inoramba iri yakavanzika panguva yekutamiswa. Vashandisi vanogona kuhwanda mumashure meVPN kuti vawane chimwe chikoro chekusazivikanwa. {project} inoremekedza yeunyu hwako nekugadzirwa.

crossPlatform.title: Mapuratifomu akasiyana
crossPlatform.description: Software inowanikwa pamapuratifomu eWindows, Linux neimacOS. Ishandise pamuchina chero upi waunoda.

download.title: Dhaunirodha
download.description: Wana {project} yepuratifomu yako. Madhaunirodha ese mahara uye open source.

macos.title: Cherechedzo yakakosha kuvashandisi vemacOS:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper inovharira maapps asina kusainwa / asina kusimbiswa akadhaunirodhwa kubva pa-internet ne{error} ekanganiso.
macos.runCommand: Pamashure pekudhaunirodha DMG kana ZIP, mhanyisa command muTerminal nemheteero inotevera usati wavhura app:
macos.explanation: Izvi zvinobvisa chinhu che-quarantine uye zvinobvumira app kuti imhanye.
